svg.title: If our virtual people aged like the field data, how do the results move?
svg.desc: Grouped bar chart, simulation sensitivity. Age table (40 cm): Shipped bench population (Hofstetter mean) 42.0%, Field-calibrated: add = keep half in reserve 41.1%, Field-calibrated: add = minimum plus 30.3%; Rack card at 14 in: Shipped bench population (Hofstetter mean) 50.9%, Field-calibrated: add = keep half in reserve 56.8%, Field-calibrated: add = minimum plus 63.4%; Small Print start: Shipped bench population (Hofstetter mean) 69.7%, Field-calibrated: add = keep half in reserve 59.5%, Field-calibrated: add = minimum plus 48.8%; Small Print + try-on (0.50 stock): Shipped bench population (Hofstetter mean) 84.6%, Field-calibrated: add = keep half in reserve 83.2%, Field-calibrated: add = minimum plus 85.1%; Small Print + try-on (0.25 stock): Shipped bench population (Hofstetter mean) 85.4%, Field-calibrated: add = keep half in reserve 84.9%, Field-calibrated: add = minimum plus 85.8%.
svg.text: If our virtual people aged like the field data, how do the results move?
Same 20,000 virtual people; only their accommodation changes, re-calibrated to the Asmara field adds (two readings of "add").
